_: GENERATED — what an authoring tool needs to FIND an operation. The calling table is the .lua beside it.

operations.name: Add a layer
operations.description: Adds a text, image, AI image, rectangle or circle layer to a design.

uid.description: The ID of the template, shown in the editor and returned by `GET /templates`.

type.description: The kind of layer to add.

pageIndex.description: The page of a multipage design. Defaults to the first page.

text.description: The text of a text layer.

imageUrl.description: The image of an image layer.

prompt.description: The prompt of an AI Image layer.

aiModel.description: The model of an AI Image layer.

aiAspectRatio.description: The aspect ratio of an AI Image layer.

operations.name: Create an empty design
operations.description: Creates a design with an empty canvas. Add layers to it, then render it with `POST /designs/{uid}`.

workspaceUid.description: The workspace to create the design in.

operations.name: Create a workspace
operations.description: Creates a workspace. Account admins only.

operations.name: Delete a generated image
operations.description: Permanently deletes a generated image. Both path parts come from the image URL: for `https://edge.dynapictures.com/ff01d10f8d/9be4738250.png` they are `ff01d10f8d` and `9be4738250.png`.

teamUid.description: The first path segment of the image URL.

filename.description: The file name in the image URL.

operations.name: Delete a layer
operations.description: Removes a layer from a design.

uid.description: The ID of the template, shown in the editor and returned by `GET /templates`.

operations.name: Delete a media asset
operations.description: Permanently deletes an asset.

operations.name: Delete a workspace
operations.description: Permanently deletes a workspace with all its templates, media and generated images. This cannot be undone. Workspace admins only.

operations.name: Generate a pdf from many pages
operations.description: Renders any number of pages, from one template or from several, into one PDF returned in the response. Pages render one after another, and each uses one image credit.

templateId.description: The template for the pages. May be left out only if every page has its own.

metadata.description: Custom metadata stored for each page.

pages.description: The pages of the PDF, in order.

operations.name: Generate an image from a template
operations.description: Renders a template with your data and returns the image URLs. Works for single-page templates (`params`), multipage templates (`pages`) and PDFs (`format: pdf`). Each image or PDF page uses one image credit. Requests are not idempotent, so a repeated request uses another credit.

uid.description: The ID of the template, shown in the editor and returned by `GET /templates`.

format.description: Output format. `pdf` is for multipage templates and produces one file with every page.

metadata.description: Custom data stored on the generated image and returned in responses and webhooks.

params.description: New values for the layers of a single-page template.

pages.description: New values for the pages of a multipage template, instead of `params`.

responseFormat.description: `binary` returns the image bytes instead of JSON. Single-page image designs only.

operations.name: Get an ai generation job
operations.description: Returns the state of a job, and the result URL once it is done.

operations.name: Get a media asset
operations.description: Returns one asset.

operations.name: Get a template
operations.description: Returns one template with its layer names, which are what `POST /designs/{uid}` overrides.

uid.description: The ID of the template, shown in the editor and returned by `GET /templates`.

operations.name: List media assets
operations.description: Lists the images and folders of a workspace, 30 per page.

operations.name: List templates
operations.description: Lists the templates with "Sync to Zapier" enabled, with their layer names.

operations.name: List workspaces
operations.description: Lists the workspaces the caller belongs to.

operations.name: Render an image from a url
operations.description: Generates an image with a single GET, so it works inside an `` tag. Needs no API key. Identical URLs return a cached image and use no further credit. If the quota is exhausted and the design has a fallback image, that image is served instead.

uid.description: The ID of the template, shown in the editor and returned by `GET /templates`.

params.description: Layer overrides as `{layer}---{property}___{value}`, joined with `<>`. The whole value must be URL-encoded.

metadata.description: Custom data stored on the generated image.

operations.name: Change a layer's stacking order
operations.description: Moves a layer in front of or behind the others.

uid.description: The ID of the template, shown in the editor and returned by `GET /templates`.

op.description: Move the layer relative to the others. Takes precedence over `zIndex`.

operations.name: Replace a media asset
operations.description: Uploads a new image for an existing asset.

folderUid.description: The folder to put it in.

operations.name: Resize the canvas
operations.description: Changes the canvas size of a design.

uid.description: The ID of the template, shown in the editor and returned by `GET /templates`.

operations.name: Search generated images
operations.description: Finds images generated by the caller's teams, oldest first, up to 200 per request. Narrow a large result with `startDate` and `endDate`.

keyword.description: Full-text search in metadata and parameters.

startDate.description: Generated at or after this time, in ISO 8601.

endDate.description: Generated before this time, in ISO 8601.

operations.name: Start an ai image generation
operations.description: Starts generating a standalone image, not tied to a template, and returns immediately. Poll the `Location` URL every 2 seconds or so until `status` is `done` or `error`; generation usually takes 10 to 60 seconds. Uses AI credits, charged only on success.

modelId.description: The AI model. The API reference lists every model with its credit cost, e.g. `flux-2-pro`, `gemini-3.1-flash-image` or `gpt-image-2-med`.

prompt.description: What to generate. May contain `[name]` tokens that refer to `referenceImages`.

ratio.description: The aspect ratio. Supported ratios vary by model.

sourceImage.description: URL of a photo to edit. Leave it out for text-to-image.

referenceImages.description: Named reference images. At most 6 input images in total, counting `sourceImage`.

operations.name: Subscribe a webhook
operations.description: Sends a POST to `targetUrl` each time the event happens for the template. `NEW_IMAGE`: an image was generated; a multipage template rendered as images sends one per page. `NEW_DOCUMENT`: a document was generated, either a multipage template rendered into one PDF or a `pptx` file. A webhook receives one event type, so subscribe once per type to get both. The request bodies are described under `webh

targetUrl.description: The URL that receives the notifications.

eventType.description: The event to subscribe to: `NEW_IMAGE` (a new image) or `NEW_DOCUMENT` (a multipage PDF or a `pptx` file).

templateId.description: The template to watch. The webhook gets notifications for this template only.

operations.name: Unsubscribe a webhook
operations.description: Removes every webhook of your account with this `targetUrl` and `eventType`, on all templates. `templateId` is not used.

targetUrl.description: The URL that receives the notifications.

eventType.description: The event to subscribe to: `NEW_IMAGE` (a new image) or `NEW_DOCUMENT` (a multipage PDF or a `pptx` file).

templateId.description: The template to watch. The webhook gets notifications for this template only.

operations.name: Update a layer
operations.description: Changes the position, size, text or styles of a layer. Only the fields you send change.

uid.description: The ID of the template, shown in the editor and returned by `GET /templates`.

styles.description: CSS-like style properties to merge into the layer.

operations.name: Rename a workspace
operations.description: Changes the name of a workspace. Account admins only.

operations.name: Upload an image
operations.description: Uploads an image to the media library. Images already in the library render faster, because they don't have to be downloaded first.

folderUid.description: The folder to put it in.

operations.name: Upload an image from a url
operations.description: Adds an image to the media library from a public URL or from base64.

url.description: Public URL of the image. Set this or `base64`.

base64.description: The image as base64. Set this or `url`.

mimeType.description: The MIME type, mainly useful with `base64`.

folderUid.description: The folder to put it in.
